origin.thread_label: Alpha Lab adversarial operator anticipation / counting gate

title: Execute frozen adversarial-operator Stage A / Stage B counting gate
objective: Implement the smallest deterministic SHADOW-ONLY counting executor for the already-frozen ADVERSARIAL_OPERATOR_FORWARD_COHORT_v1 counting gate. Reuse existing Robinhood/Pons launch-event evidence, raw RPC transaction calldata and existing Blockscout/RPC bindings. Stage A must be cheap and broad, decode launch-time privileged/exemption surface without outcome lookup where possible, and never claim operator identity. Stage B may run only on Stage-A qualified rows and may add funding ancestry / money-lineage evidence after explicit benign-infrastructure exclusions. Emit denominator counts and machine-readable evidence only. Do not create a new scheduler, scanner, score, threshold, alert rule, trading engine, API budget or portfolio authority.

Donh91/Investering-Framework-Archive-v1:scripts/api_agent/meme_alpha_blockscout.py only if a generic read-only transaction/funding helper is required
Donh91/secrets:collectors/memes_alpha/** only for bounded restricted-plane ancestry enrichment that reuses the existing runtime

evidence.summary: The Stage 1/Stage 2 qualification and review-budget semantics are already frozen prospectively.
Claude denominator/base-rate findings plus independent Bitquery cross-check establish why a counting gate is required before any first-pump strategy research.
Existing exact-CA enrichment already decodes Pons launch input including snipeTaxExemptions and must be reused rather than duplicated where provider enrichment is needed.

evidence.ref: Donh91/Meme-Alpha-Lab historical/prospective Robinhood Pons event corpus
evidence.summary: Existing research corpus preserves token, deployer, pair token, block/log and launch tx identity and is the intended denominator input. It is read-only evidence, not a new owner.
Existing adversarial runtime wiring is production-shaped and fail-closed; no parallel runtime is required.

reproduction: From fresh main, confirm ADVERSARIAL_OPERATOR_FORWARD_COHORT_v1 is frozen but no deterministic executable currently emits its raw_fires_per_day, qualified_fires_per_day, benign_infra_share, seed_overlap and ordinary_control_overlap fields from a bounded launch interval. Confirm existing Pons launch evidence exposes exact token/tx/deployer/pair/block identity and existing Pons/Blockscout code can decode launchAndBuy exemption fields. The defect is reproduced if the scientific counting contract exists but no bounded executable can produce the frozen Stage-A/Stage-B denominator receipt without manual hindsight labeling.

positive: A bounded invocation accepts an outcome-blind contiguous Robinhood/Pons launch interval or immutable event manifest and emits every launch row, including NO_HIT / enrichment-failure rows.
Stage A decodes the documented Pons launchAndBuy privileged/exemption surface from raw launch transaction evidence when available and records UNKNOWN rather than dropping undecodable rows.
Stage A never labels a token as same-operator solely from shared Pons factory/router, relaunch/retry, quote token, fresh-wallet count or exemption count.
Stage B runs only for rows that satisfy the already-frozen Stage-A qualification and records the reason for admission.
Stage B explicitly excludes Relay, bridge, CEX, router, Pons factory/protocol and other classified benign infrastructure before common-funder/operator-lineage evidence can qualify.
Output contains raw_fires_per_day, qualified_fires_per_day, benign_infra_share, known-seed overlap, ordinary-control overlap, source health and immutable input/output hashes.
BYTE, CRUMBS, DRAFT, DEED, PINK and LEGS exact CAs can be supplied as regression seeds without outcome values influencing qualification.
The executor is research-only and can be called by existing research/runtime ownership without a new scheduler or scanner.
negative: No market-return, ATH, future price, caller reputation or later outcome may be read before Stage-A/Stage-B qualification is frozen.
Missing transaction decode, funding ancestry or infrastructure classification must remain UNKNOWN and must not be converted to zero/no-risk.
A common Pons creator/factory address must not count as operator lineage.
A Relay/router/bridge/CEX/shared protocol path must not satisfy common-funder/operator-lineage qualification.
The task must not change the <=10/day or 50% review-budget semantics, invent new thresholds, or tune Stage A/Stage B after outcome inspection.
No auto-buy, auto-sell, portfolio action, user alert, market gate, model weight, API budget, score or canonical promotion may be added.
No new workflow, scheduler, parallel runtime, evidence ledger or separate scanner may be created.
